message.content: {"mechanism_id":"seed_conditioned_memory_reset","target_component":"F/CR memory (M_F, M_CR) initialization and update","observed_evidence":{"task_id":"TASK-05","trace_path":"diagnostic_trace_summary","function":"F11","seed":11,"metric":"diversity","observed_value":0.175},"causal_hypothesis":"Early Cauchy draws of F can be tiny for some seeds, collapsing M_F toward 0.08 and freezing mutation step size; seed 11 escaped this because its early F draws stayed larger, so seed sensitivity originates in the memory update path rather than the population.","algorithmic_change":"Add a per-memory-cell stagnation counter: if the Lehmer update of M_F[k] changes it by less than a threshold for G_stall consecutive generations, reinitialize that cell from Cauchy(0.5,0.2) and reset its counter.","mathematical_rule":"delta_k = |M_F_new[k] - M_F_old[k]|; if delta_k < eps (eps=0.01) then stall_k = stall_k + 1 else stall_k = 0; if stall_k >= G_stall (G_stall=15) then M_F[k] = Cauchy(0.5, 0.2), stall_k = 0.","expected_effect":"Prevents M_F from being trapped at small values on unlucky seeds, restoring mutation scale and raising diversity on seeds 22/33 toward seed 11's 0.175 while preserving fast convergence when memory is actively learning.","failure_prediction":"On unimodal or easy functions where small F is genuinely optimal, forced resets may inject disruptive mutations and slow convergence; may also trigger repeatedly if eps is too small relative to natural Lehmer noise.","ablation_plan":"Compare baseline vs. mechanism on F11 seeds 11/22/33 and F1-F13; ablate G_stall in {5,15,30} and eps in {0.001,0.01,0.05}; report per-seed diversity, success_rate, and final fitness variance across 25 seeds.","nearest_known_methods":"SHADE/L-SHADE memory adaptation, jSO memory weighting, restart strategies with memory reinitialization, adaptive F scaling.","implementation_requirements":"Add stall_k array of length H alongside M_F; modify memory update in lshade_canonical.py after Lehmer mean; expose eps and G_stall as parameters; no change to population or archive logic."}
